describe: a straight stretch of mainline railway track seen from straight above, as a texture that repeats along its length: blue-grey crushed-stone ballast filling the whole strip edge to edge; 12 evenly spaced light concrete sleepers lying across it with dark rail fastening clips where the rails cross them; two steel rails running the whole length exactly on the two thin grey guide lines, each a bright worn running strip with a dark brown edge either side; a faint brown rust tint on the ballast between the rails
